verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs say its for_each provider configurations are 'perfect for multi-environment setups (dev/staging/prod)', so it documents a first-party way to handle per-environment configuration. That mechanism generates environment configs inside one configuration rather than isolating them as separate stacks or workspaces, and the evidence never mentions workspaces. missing for 10: documented workspace or stack separation per environment (e.g. workspace commands, per-environment state isolation), per-environment variable/config file handling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
